findings.location: content.body.bankJustificationUk: "2 відкладені" in both modality breakdowns.
findings.description: The stated role counts differ from the packet. Written-form tasks T15 and T16 are respectively delayed and transfer; context-choice tasks T19 and T20 are respectively delayed and transfer. Each breakdown therefore contains one task of each role, rather than two delayed tasks.
findings.suggestion: Replace each occurrence of "2 відкладені" with "1 відкладене, 1 на перенесення", or explicitly describe the pair as two held-out tasks.
